messages:
Maya (PM): quick thread: revamping DP invite flow to reduce friction and improve signal. want a final ops + legal check before we send.
Priya (PartnerOps): summary of changes: 1) single-click calendar + auto-ICS, 2) 12 business day RSVP window, 3) intake asks for two prompts + use-case description, 4) optional accessibility needs checkbox, 5) tiered credits tied to active eval submissions.
Rahul (Eng): dev notes: we need to pin model family + quant profile per cohort 96h before kickoff. also add a feature-flag gate so we can toggle experimental endpoints per partner.
Tom (Legal): NDA timing: we can surface a pre-signed NDA link, but require explicit consent checkbox during intake. recommend "we'll counter-sign within 3 biz days" line. also flag any govt healthcare orgs for review.
Zoe (Res): signal goals: capture 3 representative prompts (happy path, edge case, adversarial). ask partners to run a 10-min smoke test we auto-eval. want one automated metric (synthetic pass rate) >= 60% before scheduling deep session.
Maya (PM): good. success metrics for the wave: 1) 20 live partners (active usage >= 100 tokens/week) within 4 weeks, 2) avg quality score >= baseline, 3) at least 8 product-usable feature requests, 4) NPS >= 30 from participants.
Priya (PartnerOps): intake survey draft snippet: 
```
- Company name
- Use case summary (1-2 sentences)
- Two sample prompts (required)
- Expected weekly usage estimate
- Accessibility requirements (checkbox + free text)
- GDPR/data residency concerns (checkbox)
- Preferred kickoff times (timezone)
```
Maya (PM): include an optional field: "Would you share anonymized logs for research?" with clear privacy explanation.
Tom (Legal): add: "By submitting you agree to our DP pilot terms" + link to short TOS. ensure opt-out for telemetry.
Rahul (Eng): infra: add pilot-burst guardrails: default cap = 2x historic committed baseline, auto-alert + temp-throttle if >3x. we can grant manual burst after infra review.
invite-bot: automation scheduled: non-responder pings at day 5 and day 10; calendar auto-send when NDA completed.
Priya (PartnerOps): incentives: 300 credits + 1 research call (low), 1200 + 2 calls + co-marketing (mid), 2500 + 3 calls + product spotlight (high). bonus credit if they complete 3 weekly eval runs.
Zoe (Res): timeline: intake -> auto-smoke eval -> research triage -> kickoff. want to freeze cohort eval config (seed prompts + metrics) 48h after RSVP window closes.
Maya (PM): launch checklist before send: invite template final, intake form live, NDA link validated, invite automation toggles tested, infra caps set, research smoke eval script ready, comms copy approved.
Tom (Legal): legal checkpoint: mark any healthcare/finance customers, require additional review checkbox.
Rahul (Eng): I'll add a small webhook that posts intake results + smoke-eval summary to the cohort channel so Eng/Res can triage quickly. rate-limit to avoid noise.
Priya (PartnerOps): message tone for emails: short subject "Invitation: Redwood Design Partner Pilot"; body: 2 bullets "what we need from you" + "what you get" + timeline. include clear CTA buttons: "Accept invite" "Ask a question".
Maya (PM): final owners: Priya owns invite copy & sheet; Rahul owns infra & webhook; Zoe owns smoke eval config; Tom owns legal text. target send date = next Wed. any objections?
Zoe (Res): minor ask: include a checkbox for "preferred language" so we can allocate translation for non-English partners.
Maya (PM): done. if no other issues i'll post the invite draft to #product-docs and schedule a 15-min review tomorrow. :seedling:
